newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Seminar to provide and finance health services in Gulf Arab states opened in Riyadh on Saturday.
- The World Bank agrees to finance Aden free trade zone projects.
- Future ownership of Gulf Air to be decided in next few weeks.
The Bahrain-based regional carrier Gulf Air is owned by the governments of Bahrain, Oman, Qatar and Abu Dhabi emirate in the United Arab Emirates.
- Yemen allocates $346 million for service projects.
